sources.observation: The white lattice mast tapers gradually above its curving outer ribs. The bronze-colored mesh sweeps across the curved theatre roof. Open stairs link the raised apron to the lawn.

limitations: The bronze canopy net geometry, stepped apron and count of structural struts are estimated from photographs. The model covers the exterior of the Theatres Building and its mast.
